units.source_text: 他得了失眠病，而且体力也日渐衰弱了。

en.t: He developed insomnia, and his physical strength also grew weaker day by day.

units.source_text: 不同的几位医生给他的病做了两三种诊断：胃酸过多、胃弛缓、干性肋膜炎、神经衰弱、慢性结膜炎、脑疲劳……

en.t: Several different doctors gave two or three diagnoses for his illness: excess stomach acid, gastric atony, dry pleurisy, neurasthenia, chronic conjunctivitis, brain fatigue...
